summary: Kootenai National Forest 60-foot steel Aermotor lookout near Whitefish, MT: built 1934, staffed until 1973, removed 1975; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 60-foot steel Aermotor tower; log cabin living quarters burned in 1963 and were replaced by trailer quarters
facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1975; no source describes what remains at the site today

events.note: Log cabin living quarters burned accidentally; replaced by trailer living quarters (firelookout.com)

July 25, 1975 Kootenai National Forest notice soliciting bids for excess buildings and property, including a steel lookout tower without cabin on Sunday Mountain; bids due 2 p.m. Aug. 11 (quoted from The Daily Inter Lake on Forest Lookouts)
Removed in 1975 per firelookout.com; the same year the forest offered it for sale

notes_for_editor: Two independent-ish pages (firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts) agree on the 1934 build, staffing to 1973 and 1975 removal. The Forest Lookouts page quotes a 1975 Daily Inter Lake bid notice; the original newspaper was not reached. The notice offers the tower for sale, while firelookout.com says it was removed in 1975; the sources do not show whether it was sold, dismantled or left standing. Height 18.3 m is converted from the listed 60 ft. Access level omitted because no source states it. Two WebSearch queries found no other record of the site. Coordinates are from the firelookout.org list and are not in the story.
